name: Steam Link
tagline: Stream games from another computer with Steam
blurb: The Steam Link app allows you to stream games from your other computers.
description:
The Steam Link app allows you to stream games from your other
computers. Just plug in a controller, connect to a computer
running Steam on the same local network, and start playing your
existing Steam games.

install.label: Flatpak
install.note: Works on every distribution, sandboxed and kept up to date for you.
